covered_cases: arbitrary network splits including inside multibyte UTF-8 retain the same JSON objects
LF and CRLF delimiters and multiline data fields are accepted
comments, event names and IDs do not change data projection
DONE suppresses its own event without hiding later terminal data
a final data event is flushed without a blank delimiter
each event has an independent 1 MiB aggregate data limit
invalid JSON and non-object JSON have stable content-free failure reasons
side_effects: none; the parser retains bytes only until the current bounded event finishes
